product.description: În anii șaizeci, Athene Forster era cea mai strălucitoare fată din generația sa. Poreclită Ultima Debutantă, era frumoasă, răsfățată și sălbatică. Când a fost de acord să se căsătorească cu chipeșul moștenitor Douglas Fairley-Hulme, părinții ei au răsuflat ușurați. Însă la numai doi ani de la căsătorie, începuseră să circule zvonuri despre relația lui Athene cu un tânăr comis-voiajor. Treizeci și cinci de ani mai târziu, Suzanna Peacock se străduiește să facă față moștenirii lăsate de mama ei. Singurul loc în care Suzanna găsește alinare este Peacock Emporium, magazinul elegant pe care îl deschide și între ai cărui pereți magici descoperă nu doar prietenia și o evadare din căsnicia cu probleme, ci și prima pasiune adevărată a vieții ei. # Bazarul visurilor by Litera (Jojo Moyes)

The captivating **Bazarul visurilor** is a superb addition to the romance novels collection from Litera. Immerse yourself in a story of destiny, mystery, and true love with this highly anticipated novel by Jojo Moyes.

## Discover the Magic of Bazarul visurilor

Set against rich historical backdrop, *Bazarul visurilor* introduces us to Athene Forster in the 1920sâthe most brilliant girl of her generation, known as "The Last Debutante." Her life seems perfectly set when she agrees to marry the wealthy heir Douglas Fairley-Hulme.

However, happiness is never guaranteed. Just two years into their marriage, rumors begin circulating about Athene's relationship with a young traveling salesman. Decades later, we meet Suzanna Peacock, who struggles to manage the inheritance left by her mother. For Suzanna, finding solace means visiting the elegant Peacock Emporium. Within these magical walls, she discovers not only friendship and an escape from a troubled marriage but also the first true passion of her life.

As Suzanna navigates family expectations and personal turmoil, she must confront both her past and herself. Only by facing her family and confronting her own heart can she finally come to terms with what was lost and bravely face the future. This novel is a beautiful journey of self-discovery and enduring love.

## About the Author: Jojo Moyes

*Bazarul visurilor* is part of the acclaimed body of work by **Jojo Moyes**, an author celebrated for her emotional depth, humor, and profound understanding of the human condition. Jojo Moyes has penned international bestsellers including *Me Before You*, *Me After*, *I Me You*, *The Last Song*, *A Man and a Woman*, *In Pursuit of Happiness*, *Silver Bay*, and *A Ticket to Paris*.

Fans who loved her previous works, such as *Before I Loved You* or *After We Lost You*, will find themselves captivated by the emotional resonance of this new release.
